description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and data science to ship models and algorithms that directly influence Instacart 's profitability and shopper experience at scale.
The Logistics & ML group is responsible for the intelligence and execution behind Instacart ’s fulfillment system. The team optimizes a multi-sided marketplace to ensure customers get their orders on-time and in high quality, shoppers get efficient and fulfilling work, and retailers and consumer brands get reasonable business. • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions to tackle practical challenges in the marketplace.

• Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and backend engineers to deeply understand business needs and create impactful ML applications.

• Actively engage with diverse stakeholders to ensure that solutions are well-integrated and aligned with business goals.

• Push the envelope on our operational efficiency by continually refining and advancing our algorithms and models.

• 3+ years of industry experience using machine learning to solve real-world problems with large datasets

• Are a strong communicator who can collaborate with diverse stakeholders across all levels

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Feature Engineer (AI-native)
description:
The Mission

Voyagu is a travel operations platform , a large product that powers travel agencies end to end - trip economics, sales, ticketing, accounting and marketing - with a wide range of integrations with GDS and external services (payments, email, calls/SMS and more). Many kinds of users work inside it, from agents and searchers to back-office teams, and the agencies’ own clients interact with the platform through a separate web interface.

We're hiring a Feature Engineer, who owns features end to end and drives an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a daily engineering tool.

The Bet We're Making

We bet on speed of thinking and quality of work with an agent , not years of stack. We want an engineer who, with an AI agent, ships like a stronger engineer - because they lead the agent instead of clicking "accept."

You write a plan, break work into steps, verify each step, reason about the output, and give precise next instructions. You don't trust code you haven't verified. If your style is "generate it and click around the UI until it seems to work," this isn't for you - and vice versa.

You Care Why, Not Just How

You engage with the business problem, not just the ticket. You don't need to know travel - the domain is specific and nobody arrives knowing it. What matters is that you get curious about why a feature exists, who needs it, and what changes once it ships. When a business stakeholder comes to you, that conversation is interesting, not an interruption. That habit is a large part of what we're selecting for.

Tech Stack

•
Backend: Python (SQLAlchemy, GraphQL, PostgreSQL) - complex queries against a rich data model. Writing complex SQL itself is something an agent helps with. The judgment around it is on you.

•
Frontend: Angular - kept deliberately thin, with help available for the harder parts. You don’t need to be a frontend expert, just the kind of person who says “I’ll take the feature,” not “that’s not my layer.”

•
Agent: Claude Code / Cursor / Codex as a normal, daily tool (your choice of agent).

What You'll Do

• Own features end to end across the platform: economics, sales, ticketing, integrations and more.

• Build services in Python (SQLAlchemy, GraphQL, PostgreSQL) with correct transactional behavior.

• Integrate external systems: GDS, payments, email, calls/SMS and other services.

• Ship the full slice of a feature, including the Angular frontend when it needs it.

• Work with an AI agent daily - plan, steps, verification - owning quality, not volume of generated lines.

• Grow scope fast as the team and responsibilities expand.

What We're Looking For

• Solid backend development experience in Python .

• Strong understanding of database transactions and data correctness; comfortable with complex queries (mandatory) .

• Real, daily experience working with an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) - a requirement, not a plus .

• A disciplined process: planning, step-by-step work, verifying your own code.

• Genuine interest in the business behind the code - you can explain what problem a feature solved and who it served.

• Willingness and ability to work across the stack, including frontend. You own features, not layers.

• English B2+ (working level).

Why Voyagu

• A large, real product - a travel operations platform with many domains, so you get variety and depth, not one narrow corner.

• An AI-first engineering culture: the agent is the norm, not a banned tool.

• Fast-growing responsibility for people who deliver.

• Fully remote, start ASAP.

- Talent Development: Recruit, onboard, and retain top-tier sales talent. Build a clear path for AEs to grow within the revenue organization.

- Coaching Mindset: Deep passion for people development. You know how to diagnose skill gaps in a sales cycle and coach reps on discovery, multi-stakeholder alignment, and urgency building.

- Data-Driven: Proficient in CRM hygiene (Salesforce/HubSpot) and using data to identify bottlenecks in the sales funnel.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment. You are comfortable building playbooks, not just executing existing ones.
